name: La Atalaya (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Atalaya (quartered, a watchtower on red, a cork oak on white, a rockrose on yellow and a castle on blue).
history: Municipal flag of La Atalaya; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: La Atalaya arms — quartered, watchtower on red, cork oak on white, rockrose on yellow and castle on blue
